span.p:
🪝 1. UserInput 触发点
• Prompt Injection 越狱注入扫描
• 敏感合规词前置清洗

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(146, 64, 14) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🪝 2. PreToolUse 触发点 (最关键核心安检门)
• 危险命令硬阻断 (如 rm -rf, DROP DB)
• 参数合规审计与动态参数重写 (Overwrite)

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: ⚙️ 操作系统 / 外部 API 物理执行

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🛑 判定 Deny: 强行硬阻断
❓ 判定 Ask: 挂起前端弹窗审批

div.style: color: rgb(146, 64, 14) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🪝 3. PostToolUse 触发点
• 敏感密钥与私有 Token 自动脱敏
• 极端超大终端输出二次安全截断

div.style: color: rgb(146, 64, 14) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🪝 4. SubagentSpawn 触发点
• 子代理并发总数熔断配额检查
• 强制注入只读沙箱环境配置

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(146, 64, 14) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🪝 5. AgentExit 触发点
• 孤儿进程清理与临时目录物理抹除
• 审计日志持久化归档与单测报告核验
